assessments.reasoning: The object argument section makes a distinction between the reference and the underlying object and describes both the property mutation and reference rebinding outcomes for passing by value.

challenge.method: Compare mutation of a shared referent with reassignment of a copied reference. Contrast separately described reference-mode objects, read-only arguments, structures, and the posted-call lifetime case.
challenge.results: Property mutation uses the original shared object. Rebinding the callee’s copied reference leaves the caller variable bound as it was. Reference-mode rebinding and structure-value copying are distinct controls. The live-object condition excludes the example where a posted consumer encounters a destroyed object.

limitations: The test is a documentary comparison of parameter modes. No lifetime extension, object clone, or mutability guarantee outside the argument rules follows.
